beats.summary: Michael announces that David Wallace approved making the first Dunder Mifflin television commercial.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hey, everybody, I just got off the phone with David Wallace, and he has given us the go-ahead to make the first ever Dunder Mifflin television commercial.

beats.summary: Michael expresses concern about having Darryl do the music due to potential racial stereotyping.
Jim comments on Michael's mission to prove his creativity and notes Michael's unique way of thinking.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Michael is on a mission to prove that he's creative.
Michael actually might be the most creative person I've ever known. Every day, Michael says and thinks things that no one has ever said or thought before.
